title: TEOS Rendered Artifact
description: Machine-readable provenance contract for a generated document, package, feed, report, or schedule. A Rendered Artifact is reproducible and replaceable output, never an authoritative source.

artifact_id.description: Stable identity of this logical generated artifact.

artifact_type.description: The canonical logical category of the artifact.

artifact_version.description: The version of this logical output contract and result.

format.description: The generated output format, independent of artifact type.

generation_timestamp.description: The timestamp at which the artifact was generated.

generator_identity.description: The stable name or identifier of the generating component.

generator_version.description: The exact version of the generating component.

renderer.description: The renderer and exact renderer version that produced the presentation.

source_references.description: Every exact curriculum, profile, calendar, schedule, policy, and other authoritative version that materially affected the output. This relationship is intentionally polymorphic.

template_reference.description: The exact template used to generate the artifact, when a template was used.

validation_status.description: The recorded validation result for the generated artifact.

complete.description: Whether the artifact represents its requested scope completely.

report_reference.description: A version-bound Rendered Artifact containing the validation report, when one exists.

notes.description: Information explaining an incomplete, conflicted, or failed result.

reproducibility_record.description: The exact generation context required to reproduce equivalent output.

language.description: The primary BCP 47 language tag of the output.

institution_profile_reference.description: The exact Institution Profile when it affected the artifact.

academic_calendar_reference.description: The exact Academic Calendar when date information affected the artifact.

schedule_reference.description: The exact schedule when placed occurrences affected the artifact.

destination_profile.description: The exact destination compatibility profile used for export.

accessibility_conformance.description: Accessibility standards or policies against which the artifact claims conformance.

content_digest.description: The content checksum used to verify generated output.

package_manifest.description: The constituent files, roles, and digests of a multi-file artifact.

path.description: The artifact-relative path of the constituent file.

role.description: The role of the constituent file in the package.

content_digest.description: The checksum of the constituent file when supported.

generation_notes.description: Non-authoritative notes about generation that do not hide validation findings.

supersedes_artifact_reference.description: The exact earlier artifact superseded by this artifact.

creation_metadata.description: Non-authoritative creation and provenance metadata associated with the artifact.

equivalence_rule.default: Instructional content and presentation are semantically equivalent.

checksum.title: Checksum
checksum.description: A content checksum encoded as an algorithm name and lowercase hexadecimal digest.

versionedComponent.title: Versioned Component
versionedComponent.description: The stable identity and exact semantic version of a generation component.

identity.description: The stable component name or identifier.

reproducibilityRecord.title: Reproducibility Record
reproducibilityRecord.description: The source and generation context needed to reproduce equivalent semantic and presentation output.

source_references.description: Exact source identities and versions of intentionally varying target types used for generation.

source_digests.description: Checksums keyed by stable source identity when available.

template_reference.description: The exact template used when applicable.

asset_references.description: Exact assets materially affecting the output.

policy_references.description: Exact policies materially affecting the output.

renderer.description: The exact renderer used when rendering is distinct from generation.

destination_contract.description: The exact destination compatibility contract used when applicable.

generation_options.description: Namespaced options that materially affected generation.

locale.description: The BCP 47 locale used during generation.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone used during generation.

deterministic_ordering.description: The ordering rule applied to generated content.

random_seed.description: The seed or equivalent deterministic input used for permitted variable generation.

toolchain_versions.description: Material toolchain component versions keyed by stable component name.

non_deterministic_values.description: Declared envelope values that may differ between otherwise equivalent outputs.

equivalence_rule.description: The rule used to compare regenerated output for equivalence.
